class.name: GroundLegMud3D
class.brief_description: Mud on a character's boots and legs.
class.description: Add as a child of a character. Each leg's mud line rises from the sole to the depth its foot sank in mud on the active [GroundSurface3D] (the slurry's depth, or the Bekker sinkage of a boot), flecks fly up the shin with the stride (more as the walk quickens), the mud takes the local clay's colour, dries over about five minutes and standing water washes it off below its surface. It turns [BaseMaterial3D]'s Mud layer on in copies of the materials of the meshes under its parent and writes the sole and knee points each physics tick: the shader lays the mud in each shin's own frame, so it stays on the leg through the walk cycle. The leg points come from the foot and lower leg bones of a [Skeleton3D] (found by name when left empty) or from four marker nodes.

method.name: get_boot_drag
method.description: The share of [param leg]'s lift the mud takes, [code]hold / (hold + leg_pull)[/code]: 0 free, towards 1 stuck. A character controller or animation can slow the foot's lift by it.

method.name: get_boot_embedment
method.description: How deep [param leg]'s sole went into sticky mud this stance, in metres.

method.name: get_boot_hold
method.description: The force the mud holds [param leg]'s boot with as it lifts, in newtons (0 while it stands, or once it has broken out). See [member boot_suction].

method.name: get_knee_bone
method.description: The lower leg bone of [param leg] (it starts at the knee).

method.name: get_knee_node
method.description: The node at the knee of [param leg], used instead of bones.

method.name: get_mud_flecks
method.description: The flecks thrown up [param leg]'s shin, 0 to 1.

method.name: get_mud_line
method.description: How high [param leg] is coated above its sole, in metres.

method.name: get_mud_wetness
method.description: 1 for fresh mud, falling to 0 as it dries.

method.name: get_sole_node
method.description: The node at the sole of [param leg], used instead of bones.

method.name: is_boot_lost
method.description: [code]true[/code] when the mud held [param leg]'s boot past [member boot_hold_limit] this stance; cleared when the foot is planted again.

method.name: set_foot_bone
method.description: Sets the foot bone of [param leg].

method.name: set_knee_bone
method.description: Sets the lower leg bone of [param leg].

method.name: set_knee_node
method.description: Sets the node at the knee of [param leg].

method.name: set_sole_node
method.description: Sets the node at the sole of [param leg].

method.name: suction_force
method.description: The suction breakout force of a sole of [param area] m² and [param width] m sunk [param depth] m in soil of undrained shear strength [param cohesion] kPa, lifted at [param speed] m/s, in newtons: [code]area * cohesion * Nc[/code], [code]Nc[/code] rising with depth / width to 9 (Vesic 1971), a quarter of it for a slow lift that lets water in under the sole.

members.member: How far the sole sits below the foot bone, in metres.
Past this hold, in newtons, the boot stays in the mud: [signal boot_lost] is emitted and [method is_boot_lost] is set. 0: never.

If [code]true[/code], sticky, saturated mud holds each boot as it lifts: the breakout force of a plate buried in soft clay (Vesic 1971), from the soil's cohesion, how deep the sole went and how fast it lifts, until the sole has come up about a quarter of its depth. Read it with [method get_boot_hold] and [method get_boot_drag]; [signal boot_released] marks the moment it comes free, for a squelch.
The force a leg lifts its foot with, in newtons, for [method get_boot_drag].
The left foot bone. Empty: found by name ("LeftFoot", "foot.L", "foot_l").
The left lower leg bone. Empty: found by name ("LeftLeg", "calf_l", "shin.L"), else the foot bone's parent.
A node at the left knee, for rigs without a skeleton. Used with [member left_sole_node].
A node at the left sole, for rigs without a skeleton.
The right foot bone. Empty: found by name.
The right lower leg bone. Empty: found by name, else the foot bone's parent.
A node at the right knee, for rigs without a skeleton.
A node at the right sole, for rigs without a skeleton.
The shin's radius, in metres: the mud covers the leg out to a little past it.
The [Skeleton3D] to read the legs from. Empty: the first one under the parent.
The boot sole's area, in square metres, for its sinkage and suction.
The boot sole's width, in metres.

signal.name: boot_lost
signal.description: Emitted when the mud holds [param leg]'s boot past [member boot_hold_limit].

signal.name: boot_released
signal.description: Emitted when [param leg]'s boot breaks out of the mud, with the most it was held by in newtons: the moment for a suction sound, louder for a larger [param force].
